description: Search point-level malaria parasite-rate survey records for P. falciparum (pf) or P. vivax (pv): site location, survey period, number examined, positive count, and parasite rate (pr), optionally filtered by country. Data: Malaria Atlas Project GeoServer WFS (data.malariaatlas.org), no auth required.

country.description: ISO3166 alpha-3 country code to filter surveys (e.g. "KEN"). Omit for all countries.

limit.description: Maximum number of survey records to return (1-200). Defaults to 50.

species.description: Malaria parasite species: "pf" (Plasmodium falciparum) or "pv" (Plasmodium vivax).

name: malaria-atlas.epidemiology.parasite_rate_survey

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Malaria Parasite Rate Survey
